purpose: Resolve the player actor's remaining absolute record field at offset +0x35.

contract.renderer: Render_BuildActorRecords tests the field and ORs sprite-attribute bit 0x1000
contract.vm_toggle: ActorVM_ToggleFacingState complements the actor field for the shared animation/movement facing selector
contract.spawn_copy: AnimationVM_SpawnOrCopyActor copies source actor offset +0x35 to the destination record

conclusion: FF7E75 is the player actor record's vertical sprite-flip state, represented in the emitted sprite attribute as bit 0x1000.
